trust_decision.summary: Text from third-party APIs (GitHub issue / StackExchange titles) and server validation error strings is treated as untrusted and must be inserted as text, not HTML, when the client-side CraftSupport dashboard widget builds DOM nodes; the decision is made only in src/web/assets/craftsupport/src/CraftSupportWidget.js.

landing_point.why: The summary names the GitHub issue title in the CraftSupport widget; FeedbackScreen.getSearchResultText (line 654-656) returns result.title, which handleSearchSuccess concatenates into an `html:` option.

fix_sites.entry_point: Dashboard CraftSupport widget, Feedback screen search (GitHub search/issues API JSON, getSearchUrl at :635-640) and Help screen search (StackExchange API JSON, :601-606); shared BaseSearchScreen.handleSearchSuccess
fix_sites.module_kind: client-side JS asset (shared base class serving two screens)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST dashboard/send-support-request (src/controllers/DashboardController.php:284-308) renders src/templates/_components/widgets/CraftSupport/response.twig:1-8 in an iframe, which calls parseSupportResponse with model validation errors
fix_sites.module_kind: client-side JS asset fed by a server controller + Twig template
build artefact (webpack output of the same source)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Second hunk (error list, src/web/assets/craftsupport/src/CraftSupportWidget.js:555) is a different data source in the same file, not a separate module; the dist bundle is just compiled output.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The support-form error list (line 555) is fed by Craft's own server-side validation messages for an admin-only form, so a solver can argue it is trusted/self-XSS and unrelated to the GitHub-title report; the Help (StackExchange) screen can be argued out of scope because the report names GitHub only, but it shares the same fixed line.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The result link must keep its HTML status indicator `<span class="status green|red">` built from getSearchResultStatus; switching the whole `html:` option to `text:` would render the markup literally. Also the result href and target=_blank must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: string result.title from GitHub search API (FeedbackScreen, src/web/assets/craftsupport/src/CraftSupportWidget.js:654-656)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Search-result anchor href comes straight from third-party JSON (result.html_url / result.link) with no http(s) scheme check, unlike the Feed widget which filters permalinks
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different mechanism (URL scheme, not HTML injection; jQuery attr-escapes the value) and GitHub/StackExchange generate these URLs themselves, so the field is not attacker-controlled the way a title is.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; producers at src/web/assets/craftsupport/src/CraftSupportWidget.js:612-614 and :646-648; contrast src/web/assets/feed/src/FeedWidget.js:23-25

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second remote field (e.g. answer count, issue label name, or excerpt) concatenated into the same `html:` string beside the status span
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The html option already mixes markup and data; adding a label badge next to the status dot is a natural feature and would be written the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Feed item date or author string concatenated into widgetHtml before $listItem.html()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same function already builds widgetHtml by string concatenation; item.date currently passes through Craft.formatDate, but a raw author/category field would fit right there (a planted WHERE-type sibling in another asset package).

O9_family: CWE-79 DOM-based XSS (third-party API and server-message strings inserted as HTML via jQuery)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (client asset) inside a PHP 8 / Yii2 application
O10_build.toolchain: npm + webpack (package.json:7 `build`) to regenerate dist; PHP/Composer for the CMS itself
services: browser or jsdom DOM with jQuery + Garnish + Craft globals
PHP + database only if exercising the support-request iframe end to end
O10_build.project_tests: None found for this widget: no file under tests/ mentions CraftSupport; behavioural tests would need a jsdom harness that mocks $.ajax and loads the source module.
